reference.source: Robbins Basic Pathology 9th Edition (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
clinicalPearls: Cherry red spot without organomegaly means Tay Sachs; with organomegaly think Niemann Pick
Crumpled tissue paper macrophages define Gaucher cells
Pompe is the lysosomal glycogen disease with infant heart failure
Hunter syndrome spares the cornea; Hurler clouds it
reference.pathophysiology: Single lysosomal hydrolase loss blocks one catabolic step, so its substrate engorges lysosomes distorting cells and organs over years. Tissue distribution of substrate (ganglioside in neurons, glycosaminoglycans in connective tissue, glycogen in liver and muscle) writes each phenotype, while residual enzyme activity grades severity.
additionalDifferentials: Gaucher versus Niemann Pick macrophage storage
Hurler versus Hunter syndrome corneal and inheritance clues
Hepatic versus muscle glycogen storage diseases
additionalInvestigations: Leukocyte or plasma enzyme activity assay
Genetic sequencing for subtype and family screening
Skeletal survey and echocardiography for burden assessment
